// diagnostic

E2702

Crypto API misuse

What

Crypto API misuse

Why

{why_text}

Fix

Replace the offending cryptographic argument with the concrete value or bound named in the diagnostic: {fix_text}

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2702: tests/ui/crypto_argon2id_literal_policy.stderr.

Error [jet.CryptoMisuse]: Crypto API misuse
  --> tests/ui/crypto_argon2id_literal_policy.jet:10:49
    |
 10 |         salt_short :: expert.argon2id(password, [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0], 8192, 1, 1, 16)
    |                                                 ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: The salt is 7 bytes, and `argon2id` takes 8..64 bytes, so the call can only fail
 Fix: Replace the offending cryptographic argument with the concrete value or bound named in the diagnostic: pass a salt of 8..64 bytes
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E2702
